_comment: The real config — see holdings.example.json for field-by-field docs.
Roster cut to three on 2026-10-16: musk, bezos and zuckerberg. The other
seven (huang, ellison, page, brin, ballmer, dell, ortega) were removed
from this file, the app's bundled seed data, family history, the
worker's state and the published snapshot — not just hidden. Later the
same day luckey, altman, amodei and trump were added (sourcing below).
Filled in 2026-09-20 from the sourcing below. Share counts drift with
every 10b5-1 sale/grant and every SEC amendment, so re-check these
against EDGAR every so often rather than treating them as permanent —
the same bar the rest of this project holds itself to.
musk.holdings[SPCX]: SpaceX and xAI merged into one entity in Feb 2026
(Fortune, 2026-02-02: https://fortune.com/2026/02/02/elon-musk-spacex-xai-ipo-trillion/)
and that entity IPO'd on Nasdaq as SPCX in June 2026 (CNBC, 2026-06-12:
https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/spacex-ipo-spcx-live-updates.html) — so
unlike a typical private stake this one really is a live, quoted
ticker now, not a hand-marked valuation. The 6.4B share figure is
Musk's total economic stake (Class A + Class B + RSUs/options) per a
2026-08 SEC filing as reported by The Motley Fool
(https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/23/a-new-sec-filing-reveals-exactly-how-many-shares-o/):
only 849M of that are the Class A shares that actually trade as SPCX;
the rest is Class B (10x voting, ~85% of total votes) plus RSUs/options.
This follows the same convention Bloomberg/Forbes trackers use — Class B
treated as economically equivalent to Class A for valuation — rather
than the Class-A-only figure, which would silently understate his
stake by roughly 7x (see net_worth()'s own docstring on why a partial
number is worse than none). If Stooq doesn't carry SPCX quotes, price
will come back missing and this worker will skip Musk that pass rather
than publish a stale number — check [quotes] stderr output for that.
musk.holdings[TSLA]: 717,112,739 shares (20.3%), Schedule 13G/A filed
2026-04-23 (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/TSLA/schedule-13g-a-tesla-inc-amended-passive-investment-disclosure-631d7da19861.html).
bezos.holdings[AMZN]: 950,400,000 shares (8.8%), per Amazon's own annual
proxy filing as of end-February 2026, as reported by The Motley Fool
2026-09-08 (https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/09/08/jeff-bezos-remains-amazons-largest-individual-shar/).
Directly filing-sourced, not derived.
zuckerberg.holdings[META]: no single current source gave an absolute
share count, so this is DERIVED: ~13% economic stake (source below) ×
~2.57B total Meta shares outstanding (Eulerpool, 2026) ≈ 334,000,000.
Stake % is distinct from his ~57-60% VOTING power, which comes from
Class B shares' 10x weighting — this app only needs the economic
(valuation-relevant) share count, not the voting one.
cashUsd/liabilitiesUsd left at 0 for all three — no confident public
figure for either (margin loan balances against pledged stock aren't
reliably disclosed in real time); per this project's own rule,
omitted/0 reads honestly, a guessed number doesn't.
socialUrl pass, added 2026-09-21: musk's was already set. zuckerberg's
is Threads (@zuck), his self-reported primary platform these days over
X. Deliberately still unset for bezos: his name search results are
dominated by fan/parody accounts with no independently confirmable
verified badge.
edgarCik pass, added 2026-09-21: each person's own SEC EDGAR reporting-
owner CIK (not their company's issuer CIK — those are different numbers,
e.g. musk's is 1494730, Tesla's is 1318605), verified against each
person's own data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK<n>.json (its 'name' field
matches). Used by edgar_check.py to surface new Form 4 activity for
review — see that script's own docstring for why it only reports a diff
rather than rewriting the holdings below itself.
Residence: zuckerberg — Palo Alto, widely and consistently reported for
years. bezos moved to Florida in 2026 (Indian Creek Village, the
"billionaire bunker").
icaoHex/tail/mmsi/vesselName pass, added 2026-09-22: real, publicly
reported and cross-corroborated identities (Mode S hexes/tails via
multiple independent aviation trackers plus 2022 press coverage; MMSIs
via MarineTraffic/VesselFinder/MyShipTracking). musk/bezos get real
Mode S hexes (tailVerified true); zuckerberg has a publicly reported
tail number too, but no confidently-sourced Mode S hex to go with it —
left unset rather than guessed, so he shows no flight card, honestly.
bezos (KORU) and zuckerberg (LAUNCHPAD) get real MMSIs (vesselVerified
true); musk has no yacht confidently linked to him, so no mmsi. Vessel
cards additionally require ais_listener.py running (see
.github/workflows/ais.yml) with an AISSTREAM_API_KEY — an mmsi here
alone doesn't light one up.
imo field (added 2026-09-23, schema only, no values filled in yet): an
optional second identifier per vessel, mirroring icaoHex/tail's
relationship on the plane side. MMSI can change when a vessel re-flags
or changes owner/name; a ship's IMO number is permanently assigned to
the hull. snapshot_worker.py's Subject.imo reads an `imo` key here when
present; ais_listener.py also captures ImoNumber off live
ShipStaticData broadcasts into ais_cache.json. Left unset rather than
guessed until a sourcing pass confirms each one.
Added 2026-10-16: luckey, altman, amodei, trump. Their wealth is mostly
private, so it's built from three kinds of figure (see
holdings.example.json for the fields):
- public stock, priced live like everyone else's (trump's DJT);
- privateStakes: a stake in a private company x that company's last
funding-round valuation, so after a new round only valuationUsd and
valuedOn change;
- privateStakesUsd: whatever's left, a single hand-set figure
described by estimateNote.
estimateAsOf/estimateSource say when and from whom the hand-set parts
were last checked; the app shows both. All four totals match Forbes'
real-time figures on 2026-10-16.
amodei: Forbes $15.5B (https://www.forbes.com/profile/dario-amodei/).
Anthropic doesn't disclose his stake; 1.606% is IMPLIED (15.5B / 965B).
Forbes estimated ~2% per cofounder in Jan 2025, before later dilution.
Valuation: $965B post-money, $65B Series H, 2026-05-28 (TechCrunch:
https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/28/anthropic-raises-65-billion-nears-1t-valuation-ahead-of-ipo/;
CNBC: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/28/anthropic-open-ai-startup-value.html).
birthDate left out: Wikipedia gives only the year (1983). Residence
left out: no source states it.
luckey: Forbes $6.0B (https://www.forbes.com/profile/palmer-luckey/).
Anduril doesn't disclose his stake; 9.84% is IMPLIED (6.0B / 61B);
analysts put it between 5% and 15%. Valuation: $61B, $5B Series H,
2026-05-13 (TechCrunch:
https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/anduril-raises-5b-doubles-valuation-to-61b/).
Reuters reported talks at ~$100B in July 2026; not used until a round
closes. No plane or yacht is publicly tied to him (Fortune reports he
flies economy).
trump: 114,750,000 DJT shares, held by the Donald J. Trump Revocable
Trust Dated April 7, 2014 (Form 4, transaction date 2026-06-19:
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001849635/000143774926021434/rdgdoc.xml;
same count in the Sept 2026 S-4). privateStakesUsd $5.8B = Forbes'
$6.6B (https://www.forbes.com/profile/donald-trump/) minus that stake
at $6.935 on 2026-10-16 (~$0.8B): real estate, crypto and other assets.
Plane: Boeing 757 \"Trump Force One\", registered N757AF, owned through
DJT Operations I LLC and in service
(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trump_Force_One; Forbes also lists
\"a 1991 Boeing 757 nicknamed Trump Force One\"). icaoHex aa3410 is
N757AF's Mode S address from the FAA's fixed N-number-to-ICAO
allocation, the same calculation that gives a835af for N628TS and
aa3908 for N758PB above. As president he mostly flies Air Force One,
which isn't tracked.
altman: Forbes $3.2B (https://www.forbes.com/profile/sam-altman/): no
OpenAI equity; stakes in Stripe, Helion and others. His Reddit stake
is NOT priced: a court document reported by Reuters on 2026-05-13
(https://www.marketscreener.com/news/openai-chief-altman-has-over-2-billion-stake-in-companies-that-dealt-with-openai-court-filing-ce7f5bdcdc81f420)
says he'd sold a Reddit stake by the end of 2025, while an Aug 2026
article still counts 12.2M shares. Conflicting sources, so no share
count until an SEC filing settles it.

people.name: Elon Musk
people.bio: Born in Pretoria, South Africa. Earned bachelor's degrees in physics and economics from the University of Pennsylvania (1997); left a Stanford PhD program in materials science after two days to co-found Zip2.

people.name: Jeff Bezos
people.bio: Born in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Graduated summa cum laude from Princeton University in 1986 with a B.S.E. in electrical engineering and computer science.

people.name: Mark Zuckerberg
people.bio: Born in White Plains, New York. Studied computer science at Harvard College, leaving in 2004 — sophomore year — to run Facebook full-time; Harvard awarded him an honorary degree in 2017.

people.name: Palmer Luckey
people.bio: Born and raised in Long Beach, California, and homeschooled. Studied journalism at California State University, Long Beach, and left to work on Oculus full-time.

people.name: Sam Altman
people.bio: Born in Chicago, Illinois, and raised in Clayton, Missouri. Attended Stanford University and left without a degree.

people.name: Dario Amodei
people.bio: Born in San Francisco, California. Earned a bachelor's degree in physics at Stanford and a doctorate in biophysics at Princeton.

people.name: Donald Trump
people.estimateNote: Real estate, crypto and other assets
people.bio: Born in Queens, New York City. Graduated from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School with a bachelor's degree in economics.
